'''Ryoko Shiraishi''' (Japanese: '''白石涼子''' ''Shiraishi Ryōko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Shiraishi was born on September 7, 1982 in {{wp|Kashiba, Nara|Kashiba}}, {{wp|Nara Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|RS}}, where she mostly provides voices for {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. Her most notable role is that of [[May's Beautifly]] and its pre-Evolutions.
